what: The GPU code of study 5's dose experiment (docs/study5-dose-registration.md): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: Each of the two dose Pods reruns pod 2's order control of seed 50000 at η_l under this code before any dose run and compares it under extension 2's numerical equivalence (scripts/study5_dose_campaigns.py, block engineering); a failure stops the Pod. The paths changed since the record it descends from add the early and late rate of a run (train.rate_schedule) and its role, the dose module, its config and the one-point scan; a run without the schedule is unchanged (tests/test_study5_dose_runs.py). A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
